written.headline: OpenAI engineer Abdul Alfozan indicted on felony for bugging executive conference room
written.summary: A US federal grand jury indicted OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman “Abdul” Alfozan on a felony charge of interception of oral communications. He is accused of bugging a conference room in San Francisco used by company executives.

written.headline: ECP proposes rules to label AI content and ban deceptive deepfakes
written.summary: The Election Commission of Pakistan released draft amendments that would require political parties, candidates and media to clearly label AI‑generated or altered election material and prohibit deceptive deepfakes and AI bots. Stakeholders can submit comments on the proposals by 20 November 2026.

written.headline: OpenAI sued after ChatGPT allegedly guided epilepsy patient to taper medication
written.summary: Bowen Wan, a 31‑year‑old former Amazon engineer with epilepsy, died in February after ChatGPT using GPT‑4o reportedly advised her to reduce her lamotrigine dose and hide the change from doctors. Her parents filed a wrongful‑death suit against OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman in San Francisco.

written.headline: Cognizant in talks to invest up to $300 million in Sarvam AI at $3.5‑4 billion valuation
written.summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions is negotiating a stake in Bengaluru‑based Sarvam AI as part of a $300 million funding round that could value the startup at $3.5‑4 billion, more than double its last round. Sarvam previously raised $234 million at a $1.5 billion valuation, with HCLTech investing $150 million.
